0022600109.text: The Mavericks are 1-1 through two games and will play their first home game of the season after a win in their last outing, sitting 9th in the West and 3rd in the Southwest, 1 game back. The Spurs are 0-2, both losses at home, on a two-game losing streak, and sit 12th in the West and 5th in the Southwest, 2 games back. The 2026-27 season series has no games yet, and Dallas lost all four meetings in 2025-26, most recently 139-120 in San Antonio on April 10, 2026. Cooper Flagg and Dereck Lively II are out for Dallas, while Caleb Martin, Jett Howard, Kyrie Irving, Santi Aldama, and Tarik Biberovic are listed as day-to-day, and San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (out) and Tobias Harris (day-to-day).
